description: This source file defines an Android Activity class named LogTextBox1 that demonstrates usage of a custom LogTextBox widget to display scrollable, appendable text within an Android app. It sets up a UI with a button that, when clicked, appends sample text to the LogTextBox.

classes.name: LogTextBox1
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a LogTextBox and a button to append text to it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, binds the LogTextBox and button, and sets click listener to append text.
